gr-213948.summary: Knights of Rizal asked the Court to stop DMCI's Torre de Manila condominium, arguing it spoils the view of the Rizal Monument. The Court dismissed the mandamus petition: no law or ordinance bars building outside Rizal Park, so the City of Manila had no clear legal duty to stop the project.

gr-171947.summary: The Court ordered government agencies, led by the DENR and MMDA, to clean up and rehabilitate Manila Bay and restore its waters to SB level (fit for swimming and contact recreation). It held that enforcing their statutory duties is ministerial and can be compelled by mandamus, and required periodic progress reports under the principle of continuing mandamus.

gr-148222.summary: Pearl & Dean sued Shoemart and North Edsa Marketing over illuminated advertising light boxes. The Court denied the petition: the copyright covered only the technical drawings, not the light boxes; with no patent, Pearl & Dean could not stop others from making them; and its claims over "Poster Ads" (trademark and unfair competition) also failed.

gr-182835.summary: Rustan Ang was convicted under the Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act (RA 9262) for sending his former girlfriend an obscene picture of a naked woman with her face attached. The Court affirmed the Court of Appeals and held that the Rules on Electronic Evidence apply only to civil, quasi-judicial and administrative proceedings, not criminal actions.

gr-203335.summary: Petitions challenging the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012 (RA 10175). The Court struck down Section 4(c)(3) on unsolicited commercial communications, Section 12 on real-time traffic data collection and Section 19 on blocking access to computer data, upheld most other provisions, and limited online libel and aiding-and-abetting liability.

gr-101083.summary: Minors, represented by their parents, sued to cancel timber license agreements, invoking the right to a balanced and healthful ecology for themselves and generations yet unborn. The Court held they could sue as a class on behalf of their own and future generations, and set aside the trial court's dismissal of their complaint.
